summary: Mongolia, Kazakhstan, Bolivia and Afghanistan come easily, Chad, Niger, Mali and Ethiopia reward a look at Africa's map, and Switzerland, Austria and Paraguay burn lives fast. Coastal guesses cost a life and show their coastline, which feels fair.
reasons: Casual found 8 (a variant who knows less of Africa found 5), losing all 5 lives on Switzerland #31, Austria #28, Paraguay #15, Nepal and Hungary; each miss shows its area and "largest" in the prompt warns off the small famous ones. Fan found 10/10.

Coastal guesses cost a life and say why ("drc": 37 km coastline, Nigeria for Niger: 853 km), like the owner's out-of-region rule; "sudan" and "congo" offer a choice for free. Areas match the source and Kazakhstan's Caspian coast is explained in its fact.
Good Blitz too: 47 answers, and the microstates that cost lives in the list (Vatican, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg) all score.
fixes: Central African Republic (#11) has no aliases: add CAR and C.A.R. Today "car" and "c.a.r." are offered as Czech Republic (did-you-mean), the wrong country.

Palestine, West Bank and Western Sahara cost a life with no figure. Give Palestine (Gaza, 40 km) and Western Sahara (1,110 km) their CIA coastline; West Bank is landlocked and not a country, so make it free rather than a silent life.
European Union and Antarctica are accepted from the coastline table and cost a life as if they were countries: drop non-country rows from that also-table.
Afghanistan's fact is wrong: Marco Polo sheep live across the Pamirs (mostly Tajikistan, also China, Kyrgyzstan and Pakistan), not only in the Wakhan Corridor. Replace it with another sourced fact.
